ruleset.name: FormaSL root locale redirect
ruleset.description: Redirect only / using explicit locale query, saved preference cookie, Accept-Language first range, and English fallback.

rules.expression: (http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "locale=pt-br")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "locale=en")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.request.uri.query eq "locale=zh-hans")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.cookie contains "formasl_locale=pt-br")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.cookie contains "formasl_locale=en")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and http.cookie contains "formasl_locale=zh-hans")
(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (lower(http.request.headers["accept-language"][0]) eq "pt" or starts_with(lower(http.request.headers["accept-language"][0]), "pt-")))

(http.host eq "formasl.org" and http.request.uri.path eq "/" and (starts_with(lower(http.request.headers["accept-language"][0]), "zh-cn") or starts_with(lower(http.request.headers["accept-language"][0]), "zh-sg") or starts_with(lower(http.request.headers["accept-language"][0]), "zh-hans")))

rules.description: English fallback for unsupported or absent language

restore_procedure: Recreate via PUT /zones/c3dc18477f9d63efa103a3fb58760c8b/rulesets/phases/http_request_dynamic_redirect/entrypoint with the rules JSON above (or re-enable in dashboard Rules > Redirect Rules). This ruleset must remain DISABLED/absent while the new site serves / — it targets legacy paths /pt-br/|/en/|/zh-hans/ and a catch-all 302 to /en/ that would bypass the new root page.
